note: The big image caches (app/assets/<dir>/…) are not published with this site — GitHub Pages stops at 1 GB. scripts/publish_site.mjs copies them into these image repos (each its own Pages site, kept under limit_mb) and rewrites ./assets/<dir>/… in the published JSON to the shard that holds the file. The repo keeps the originals; scripts keep using ./assets/… paths. Add a shard here (and its repo, Pages, deploy key secret IMG_SHARD_KEY_<n>) when the publish job warns that space is running out.
